items.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember that quote from Charlie Watts about you? [INTERVIEWEE] I do, yeah.

ctx.x: year. The last one that I did spanned two years for a couple of different reasons. But you knew, they would give you a contract and you would be — it would be typically about a year. But like I said, sometimes longer. But yeah, they give you notice and every aspect of their approach to running the operation was so professional. It was really easy. You’ve got to just get up and make it to the lobby, and everything else will take care of itself.
Do you remember that quote from Charlie Watts about you?
